summary: Added a sanitized local-to-GitHub control-plane heartbeat so GitHub-only Hermes can observe Morning, Recovery, and Closure without exposing raw reports or production data.
issues: GitHub-only Hermes could not read local controller reports and returned github_visibility_unavailable
risks: GitHub heartbeat is unavailable until the workflow is merged and the local publisher task is installed
lessons: Publish sanitized control-plane metadata as a GitHub Actions heartbeat instead of committing raw local reports
reusable_rules: Hermes reads the latest heartbeat workflow run and never treats raw report HTTP 404 as controller failure
